methods_proposed.name: Mean Baseline
methods_proposed.description: Predicts the mean value of the target from training data as a simple baseline for regression tasks.
methods_proposed.implementation_code:
def predict_mean_baseline(train_df, test_df, target_col, **params):
    import pandas as pd
    mean_value = train_df[target_col].mean()
    predictions = pd.DataFrame({'predicted': [mean_value] * len(test_df)}, index=test_df.index)
    return predictions

methods_proposed.name: Linear Regression
methods_proposed.description: Ordinary Least Squares regression using all available features to predict the target. Good for linear relationships and interpretability.
methods_proposed.implementation_code:
def predict_linear_regression(train_df, test_df, target_col, feature_cols=None, **params):
    from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
    import pandas as pd
    if feature_cols is None:
        feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != target_col]
    X_train = train_df[feature_cols].fillna(0)
    y_train = train_df[target_col]
    X_test = test_df[feature_cols].fillna(0)
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    predictions = model.predict(X_test)
    return pd.DataFrame({'predicted': predictions}, index=test_df.index)

methods_proposed.name: Random Forest Regressor
methods_proposed.description: Ensemble of decision trees that handles non-linear relationships and feature interactions. Good for complex patterns in tabular data.
methods_proposed.implementation_code:
def predict_random_forest(train_df, test_df, target_col, feature_cols=None, **params):
    from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
    import pandas as pd
    if feature_cols is None:
        feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != target_col]
    X_train = train_df[feature_cols].fillna(0)
    y_train = train_df[target_col]
    X_test = test_df[feature_cols].fillna(0)
    model = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    predictions = model.predict(X_test)
    return pd.DataFrame({'predicted': predictions}, index=test_df.index)
